passages.label: Prop. 1.1.1
passages.text: Cynthia prima suis miserum me cepit ocellis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.2
passages.text: contactum nullis ante cupidinibus.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.3
passages.text: tum mihi constantis deiecit lumina fastus

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.4
passages.text: et caput impositis pressit Amor pedibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.5
passages.text: donec me docuit castas odisse puellas

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.6
passages.text: improbus, et nullo vivere consilio.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.7
passages.text: ei mihi, iam toto furor hic non deficit anno,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.8
passages.text: cum tamen adversos cogor habere deos.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.9
passages.text: Milanion nullos fugiendo, Tulle, labores

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.10
passages.text: saevitiam durae contudit Iasidos.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.11
passages.text: nam modo Partheniis amens errabat in antris,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.12
passages.text: rursus in hirsutas ibat et ille feras;

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.13
passages.text: ille etiam Hylaei percussus vulnere rami

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.14
passages.text: saucius Arcadiis rupibus ingemuit.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.15
passages.text: ergo velocem potuit domuisse puellam:

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.16
passages.text: tantum in amore fides et benefacta valent.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.17
passages.text: in me tardus Amor non ullas cogitat artes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.18
passages.text: nec meminit notas, ut prius, ire vias.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.19
passages.text: at vos, deductae quibus est pellacia lunae

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.20
passages.text: et labor in magicis sacra piare focis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.21
passages.text: en agedum dominae mentem convertite nostrae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.22
passages.text: et facite illa meo palleat ore magis!

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.23
passages.text: tunc ego crediderim Manes et sidera vobis

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.24
passages.text: posse Cytinaeis ducere carminibus.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.25
passages.text: aut vos, qui sero lapsum revocatis, amici,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.26
passages.text: quaerite non sani pectoris auxilia.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.27
passages.text: fortiter et ferrum saevos patiemur et ignes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.28
passages.text: sit modo libertas quae velit ira loqui.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.29
passages.text: ferte per extremas gentes et ferte per undas,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.30
passages.text: qua non ulla meum femina norit iter.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.31
passages.text: vos remanete, quibus facili deus annuit aure,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.32
passages.text: sitis et in tuto semper amore pares.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.33
passages.text: nam me nostra Venus noctes exercet amaras,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.34
passages.text: et nullo vacuus tempore defit Amor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.35
passages.text: hoc, moneo, vitate malum: sua quemque moretur

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.36
passages.text: cura, neque assueto mutet amore torum.

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.37
passages.text: quod si quis monitis tardas adverterit aures,

passages.label: Prop. 1.1.38
passages.text: heu referet quanto verba dolore mea!

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.1
passages.text: Quid iuvat ornato procedere, vita, capillo

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.2
passages.text: et tenuis Coa veste movere sinus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.3
passages.text: aut quid Orontea crines perfundere murra,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.4
passages.text: teque peregrinis vendere muneribus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.5
passages.text: naturaeque decus mercato perdere cultu,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.6
passages.text: nec sinere in propriis membra nitere bonis?

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.7
passages.text: crede mihi, non ulla tuaest medicina figurae:

passages.text: nudus Amor formam non amat artificem.

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.9

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.10
passages.text: ut veniant hederae sponte sua melius,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.11

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.12
passages.text: et sciat indocilis currere lympha vias.

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.13
passages.text: litora nativis praefulgent picta lapillis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.14
passages.text: et volucres nulla dulcius arte canunt.

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.15

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.17
passages.text: non, Idae et cupido quondam discordia Phoebo,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.18

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.19
passages.text: nec Phrygium falso traxit candore maritum

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.20
passages.text: avecta externis Hippodamia rotis:

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.21
passages.text: sed facies aderat nullis obnoxia gemmis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.22
passages.text: qualis Apelleis est color in tabulis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.23
passages.text: non illis studium fuco conquirere amantes:

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.24
passages.text: illis ampla satis forma pudicitia.

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.25
passages.text: non ego nunc vereor ne sis tibi vilior istis:

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.26
passages.text: uni si qua placet, culta puella sat est;

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.27
passages.text: cum tibi praesertim Phoebus sua carmina donet

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.28
passages.text: Aoniamque libens Calliopea lyram,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.29
passages.text: unica nec desit iucundis gratia verbis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.30
passages.text: omnia quaeque Venus, quaeque Minerva probat.

passages.label: Prop. 1.2.31
passages.text: his tu semper eris nostrae gratissima vitae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.1
passages.text: Qualis Thesea iacuit cedente carina

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.2
passages.text: languida desertis Cnosia litoribus;

passages.text: qualis et accubuit primo Cepheia somno

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.4
passages.text: libera iam duris cotibus Andromede;

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.5
passages.text: nec minus assiduis Edonis fessa choreis

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.6
passages.text: qualis in herboso concidit Apidano:

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.7
passages.text: talis visa mihi mollem spirare quietem

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.8
passages.text: Cynthia consertis nixa caput manibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.9
passages.text: ebria cum multo traherem vestigia Baccho,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.10
passages.text: et quaterent sera nocte facem pueri.

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.11
passages.text: hanc ego, nondum etiam sensus deperditus omnis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.12
passages.text: molliter impresso conor adire toro;

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.13
passages.text: et quamvis duplici correptum ardore iuberent

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.14
passages.text: hac Amor hac Liber, durus uterque deus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.15
passages.text: subiecto leviter positam temptare lacerto

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.16
passages.text: osculaque admota sumere tarda manu,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.17
passages.text: non tamen ausus eram dominae turbare quietem,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.18
passages.text: expertae metuens iurgia saevitiae;

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.19
passages.text: sed sic intentis haerebam fixus ocellis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.20
passages.text: Argus ut ignotis cornibus Inachidos.

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.21
passages.text: et modo solvebam nostra de fronte corollas

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.22
passages.text: ponebamque tuis, Cynthia, temporibus;

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.23
passages.text: et modo gaudebam lapsos formare capillos;

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.24
passages.text: nunc furtiva cavis poma dabam manibus:

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.25
passages.text: omnia quae ingrato largibar munera somno,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.26
passages.text: munera de prono saepe voluta sinu;

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.27
passages.text: et quotiens raro duxti suspiria motu,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.28
passages.text: obstupui vano credulus auspicio,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.29
passages.text: ne qua tibi insolitos portarent visa timores,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.30
passages.text: neve quis invitam cogeret esse suam:

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.31
passages.text: donec diversas praecurrens luna fenestras,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.32
passages.text: luna moraturis sedula luminibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.33
passages.text: compositos levibus radiis patefecit ocellos.

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.34
passages.text: sic ait in molli fixa toro cubitum:

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.35
passages.text: 'tandem te nostro referens iniuria lecto

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.36
passages.text: alterius clausis expulit e foribus?

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.37
passages.text: namque ubi longa meae consumpsti tempora noctis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.38
passages.text: languidus exactis, ei mihi, sideribus?

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.39
passages.text: o utinam talis perducas, improbe, noctes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.3.40
passages.text: me miseram qualis semper habere iubes!

passages.text: nam modo purpureo fallebam stamine somnum,

passages.text: rursus et Orpheae carmine, fessa, lyrae;

passages.text: interdum leviter mecum deserta querebar

passages.text: externo longas saepe in amore moras:

passages.text: dum me iucundis lassam Sopor impulit alis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.1
passages.text: Quid mihi tam multas laudando, Basse, puellas

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.2
passages.text: mutatum domina cogis abire mea?

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.3
passages.text: quid me non pateris vitae quodcumque sequetur

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.4
passages.text: hoc magis assueto ducere servitio?

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.5
passages.text: tu licet Antiopae formam Nycteidos, et tu

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.6
passages.text: Spartanae referas laudibus Hermionae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.7
passages.text: et quascumque tulit formosi temporis aetas;

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.8
passages.text: Cynthia non illas nomen habere sinat:

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.9
passages.text: nedum, si levibus fuerit collata figuris,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.10
passages.text: inferior duro iudice turpis eat.

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.11
passages.text: haec sed forma mei pars est extrema furoris;

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.12
passages.text: sunt maiora, quibus, Basse, perire iuvat:

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.13
passages.text: ingenuus color et motis decor artubus et quae

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.14
passages.text: gaudia sub tacita discere veste libet.

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.15
passages.text: quo magis et nostros contendis solvere amores,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.16
passages.text: hoc magis accepta fallit uterque fide.

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.17
passages.text: non impune feres: sciet haec insana puella

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.18
passages.text: et tibi non tacitis vocibus hostis erit;

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.19
passages.text: nec tibi me post haec committet Cynthia nec te

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.20
passages.text: quaeret; erit tanti criminis illa memor,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.21
passages.text: et te circum omnis alias irata puellas

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.22
passages.text: differet: heu nullo limine carus eris.

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.23
passages.text: nullas illa suis contemnet fletibus aras,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.24
passages.text: et quicumque sacer, qualis ubique, lapis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.25
passages.text: non ullo gravius temptatur Cynthia damno

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.26
passages.text: quam sibi cum rapto cessat amore decus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.27
passages.text: praecipue nostro. maneat sic semper, adoro,

passages.label: Prop. 1.4.28
passages.text: nec quicquam ex illa quod querar inveniam!

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.1
passages.text: invide, tu tandem voces compesce molestas

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.2
passages.text: et sine nos cursu, quo sumus, ire pares!

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.3
passages.text: Quid tibi vis, insane? meae sentire furores?

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.4
passages.text: infelix, properas ultima nosse mala,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.5
passages.text: et miser ignotos vestigia ferre per ignes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.6
passages.text: et bibere e tota toxica Thessalia.

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.7
passages.text: non est illa vagis similis collata puellis:

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.8
passages.text: molliter irasci non sciet illa tibi.

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.9
passages.text: quod si forte tuis non est contraria votis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.10
passages.text: at tibi curarum milia quanta dabit!

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.11
passages.text: non tibi iam somnos, non illa relinquet ocellos:

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.12
passages.text: illa ferox animis alligat una viros.

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.13
passages.text: a, mea contemptus quotiens ad limina curres,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.14
passages.text: cum tibi singultu fortia verba cadent,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.15
passages.text: et tremulus maestis orietur fletibus horror,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.16
passages.text: et timor informem ducet in ore notam,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.17
passages.text: et quaecumque voles fugient tibi verba querenti,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.18
passages.text: nec poteris, qui sis aut ubi, nosse miser!

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.19
passages.text: tum grave servitium nostrae cogere puellae

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.20
passages.text: discere et exclusum quid sit abire domum;

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.21
passages.text: nec iam pallorem totiens mirabere nostrum,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.22
passages.text: aut cur sim toto corpore nullus ego.

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.23
passages.text: nec tibi nobilitas poterit succurrere amanti:

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.24
passages.text: nescit Amor priscis cedere imaginibus.

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.25
passages.text: quod si parva tuae dederis vestigia culpae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.26
passages.text: quam cito de tanto nomine rumor eris!

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.27
passages.text: non ego tum potero solacia ferre roganti,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.28
passages.text: cum mihi nulla mei sit medicina mali;

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.29
passages.text: sed pariter miseri socio cogemur amore

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.30
passages.text: alter in alterius mutua flere sinu.

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.31
passages.text: quare, quid possit mea Cynthia, desine, Galle,

passages.label: Prop. 1.5.32
passages.text: quaerere: non impune illa rogata venit.

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.1
passages.text: Non ego nunc Hadriae vereor mare noscere tecum,

passages.text: Tulle, neque Aegaeo ducere vela salo,

passages.text: cum quo Rhipaeos possim conscendere montes

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.4

passages.text: sed me complexae remorantur verba puellae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.6
passages.text: mutatoque graves saepe colore preces.

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.7
passages.text: illa mihi totis argutat noctibus ignes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.8
passages.text: et queritur nullos esse relicta deos;

passages.text: illa meam mihi iam se denegat, illa minatur

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.10
passages.text: quae solet ingrato tristis amica viro.

passages.text: his ego non horam possum durare querelis:

passages.text: ah pereat, si quis lentus amare potest!

passages.text: an mihi sit tanti doctas cognoscere Athenas

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.14
passages.text: atque Asiae veteres cernere divitias,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.15
passages.text: ut mihi deducta faciat convicia puppi

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.16
passages.text: Cynthia et insanis ora notet manibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.17
passages.text: osculaque opposito dicat sibi debita vento,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.18
passages.text: et nihil infido durius esse viro?

passages.text: tu patrui meritas conare anteire secures,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.20

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.22

passages.text: et tibi non umquam nostros puer iste labores

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.24
passages.text: afferat et lacrimis omnia nota meis!

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.25
passages.text: me sine, quem semper voluit fortuna iacere,

passages.label: Prop. 1.6.26
passages.text: huic animam extremam reddere nequitiae.

passages.text: multi longinquo periere in amore libenter,

passages.text: Tune igitur demens, nec te mea cura moratur?

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.2
passages.text: an tibi sum gelida vilior Illyria?

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.3
passages.text: et tibi iam tanti, quicumquest, iste videtur,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.4
passages.text: ut sine me vento quolibet ire velis?

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.5
passages.text: tune audire potes vesani murmura ponti

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.6
passages.text: fortis, et in dura nave iacere potes?

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.7
passages.text: tu pedibus teneris positas fulcire pruinas,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.8
passages.text: tu potes insolitas, Cynthia, ferre nives?

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.9
passages.text: o utinam hibernae duplicentur tempora brumae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.10
passages.text: et sit iners tardis navita Vergiliis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.11
passages.text: nec tibi Tyrrhena solvatur funis harena,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.12
passages.text: neve inimica meas elevet aura preces

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.15
passages.text: et me defixum vacua patiatur in ora

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.14
passages.text: crudelem infesta saepe vocare manu!

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.16
passages.text: sed quocumque modo de me, periura, mereris,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.17
passages.text: sit Galatea tuae non aliena viae;

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.13
passages.text: atque ego non videam talis subsidere ventos,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.18
passages.text: cum tibi provectas auferet unda rates,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.19
passages.text: ut te felici post victa Ceraunia remo

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.20
passages.text: accipiat placidis Oricos aequoribus.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.21
passages.text: nam me non ullae poterunt corrumpere, de te

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.22
passages.text: quin ego, vita, tuo limine verba querar;

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.23
passages.text: nec me deficiet nautas rogitare citatos

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.24
passages.text: 'dicite, quo portu clausa puella meast?',

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.25
passages.text: et dicam 'licet Artaciis considat in oris,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8a.26
passages.text: et licet Hylaeis, illa futura meast.'

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.27
passages.text: Hic erit! hic iurata manet! rumpantur iniqui!

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.28
passages.text: vicimus: assiduas non tulit illa preces.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.29
passages.text: falsa licet cupidus deponat gaudia livor:

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.30
passages.text: destitit ire novas Cynthia nostra vias.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.31
passages.text: illi carus ego et per me carissima Roma

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.32
passages.text: dicitur, et sine me dulcia regna negat.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.33
passages.text: illa vel angusto mecum requiescere lecto

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.34
passages.text: et quocumque modo maluit esse mea,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.35
passages.text: quam sibi dotatae regnum vetus Hippodamiae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.36
passages.text: et quas Elis opes apta pararat equis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.37
passages.text: quamvis magna daret, quamvis maiora daturus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.38
passages.text: non tamen illa meos fugit avara sinus.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.39
passages.text: hanc ego non auro, non Indis flectere conchis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.40
passages.text: sed potui blandi carminis obsequio.

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.41
passages.text: sunt igitur Musae, neque amanti tardus Apollo,

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.42
passages.text: quis ego fretus amo: Cynthia rara meast!

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.43
passages.text: nunc mihi summa licet contingere sidera plantis:

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.44
passages.text: sive dies seu nox venerit, illa meast!

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.45
passages.text: nec mihi rivalis certos subducet amores:

passages.label: Prop. 1.8b.46
passages.text: ista meam norit gloria canitiem.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.1
passages.text: Dicebam tibi venturos, irrisor, amores,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.2
passages.text: nec tibi perpetuo libera verba fore:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.3
passages.text: ecce iaces supplexque venis ad iura puellae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.4
passages.text: et tibi nunc quaevis imperat empta modo.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.5
passages.text: non me Chaoniae vincant in amore columbae

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.6
passages.text: dicere, quos iuvenes quaeque puella domet.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.7
passages.text: me dolor et lacrimae merito fecere peritum:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.8
passages.text: atque utinam posito dicar amore rudis!

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.9
passages.text: quid tibi nunc misero prodest grave dicere carmen

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.10
passages.text: aut Amphioniae moenia flere lyrae?

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.11
passages.text: plus in amore valet Mimnermi versus Homero:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.12
passages.text: carmina mansuetus lenia quaerit Amor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.13
passages.text: i quaeso et tristis istos sepone libellos,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.14
passages.text: et cane quod quaevis nosse puella velit!

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.15
passages.text: quid si non esset facilis tibi copia! nunc tu

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.16
passages.text: insanus medio flumine quaeris aquam.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.17
passages.text: necdum etiam palles, vero nec tangeris igni:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.18
passages.text: haec est venturi prima favilla mali.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.19
passages.text: tum magis Armenias cupies accedere tigres

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.20
passages.text: et magis infernae vincula nosse rotae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.21
passages.text: quam pueri totiens arcum sentire medullis

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.22
passages.text: et nihil iratae posse negare tuae.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.23
passages.text: nullus Amor cuiquam facilis ita praebuit alas,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.24
passages.text: ut non alterna presserit ille manu.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.25
passages.text: nec te decipiat, quod sit satis illa parata:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.26
passages.text: acrius illa subit, Pontice, si qua tuast,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.27
passages.text: quippe ubi non liceat vacuos seducere ocellos,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.28
passages.text: nec vigilare alio limine cedat Amor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.29
passages.text: qui non ante patet, donec manus attigit ossa:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.30
passages.text: quisquis es, assiduas tu fuge blanditias!

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.31
passages.text: illis et silices et possint cedere quercus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.32
passages.text: nedum tu possis, spiritus iste levis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.33
passages.text: quare, si pudor est, quam primum errata fatere:

passages.label: Prop. 1.9.34
passages.text: dicere quo pereas saepe in amore levat.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.1
passages.text: O iucunda quies, primo cum testis amori

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.2
passages.text: affueram vestris conscius in lacrimis!

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.3
passages.text: o noctem meminisse mihi iucunda voluptas,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.4
passages.text: o quotiens votis illa vocanda meis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.5
passages.text: cum te complexa morientem, Galle, puella

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.6
passages.text: vidimus et longa ducere verba mora!

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.7
passages.text: quamvis labentis premeret mihi somnus ocellos

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.8
passages.text: et mediis caelo Luna ruberet equis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.9
passages.text: non tamen a vestro potui secedere lusu:

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.10
passages.text: tantus in alternis vocibus ardor erat.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.11
passages.text: sed quoniam non es veritus concredere nobis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.12
passages.text: accipe commissae munera laetitiae:

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.13
passages.text: non m vestros didici reticere dolores,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.14
passages.text: est quiddam in nobis maius, amice, fide.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.15
passages.text: possum ego diversos iterum coniungere amantes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.16
passages.text: et dominae tardas possum aperire fores;

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.17
passages.text: et possum alterius curas sanare recentis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.18
passages.text: nec levis in verbis est medicina meis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.19
passages.text: Cynthia me docuit, semper quae cuique petenda

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.20
passages.text: quaeque cavenda forent: non nihil egit Amor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.21
passages.text: tu cave ne tristi cupias pugnare puellae,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.22
passages.text: neve superba loqui, neve tacere diu;

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.23
passages.text: neu, si quid petiit, ingrata fronte negaris,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.24
passages.text: neu tibi pro vano verba benigna cadant.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.25
passages.text: irritata venit, quando contemnitur illa,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.26
passages.text: nec meminit iustas ponere laesa minas:

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.27
passages.text: at quo sis humilis magis et subiectus amori,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.28
passages.text: hoc magis effectu saepe fruare bono.

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.29
passages.text: is poterit felix una remanere puella,

passages.label: Prop. 1.10.30
passages.text: qui numquam vacuo pectore liber erit.

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.1
passages.text: Ecquid te mediis cessantem, Cynthia, Baiis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.2
passages.text: qua iacet Herculeis semita litoribus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.3
passages.text: et modo Thesproti mirantem subdita regno

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.4
passages.text: proxima Misenis aequora nobilibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.5
passages.text: nostri cura subit memores adducere noctes?

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.6
passages.text: ecquis in extremo restat amore locus?

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.7
passages.text: an te nescio quis simulatis ignibus hostis

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.8
passages.text: sustulit e nostris, Cynthia, carminibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.15
passages.text: ut solet amoto labi custode puella,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.10
passages.text: perfida communis nec meminisse deos?

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.9
passages.text: atque utinam mage te remis confisa minutis

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.11
passages.text: parvula Lucrina cumba moretur aqua,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.12
passages.text: aut teneat clausam tenui Teuthrantis in unda

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.13
passages.text: alternae facilis cedere lympha manu,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.14
passages.text: quam vacet alterius blandos audire susurros

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.16
passages.text: molliter in tacito litore compositam!

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.17
passages.text: non quia perspecta non es mihi cognita fama,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.18
passages.text: sed quod in hac omnis parte timetur amor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.19
passages.text: ignosces igitur, si quid tibi triste libelli

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.20
passages.text: attulerint nostri: culpa timoris erit.

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.21
passages.text: ah mihi non maior carae custodia matris

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.22
passages.text: aut sine te vitae cura sit ulla meae!

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.23
passages.text: tu mihi sola domus, tu, Cynthia, sola parentes,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.24
passages.text: omnia tu nostrae tempora laetitiae.

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.25
passages.text: seu tristis veniam seu contra laetus amicis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.26
passages.text: quicquid ero, dicam 'Cynthia causa fuit.'

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.27
passages.text: tu modo quam primum corruptas desere Baias:

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.28
passages.text: multis ista dabunt litora discidium,

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.29
passages.text: litora quae fuerunt castis inimica puellis:

passages.label: Prop. 1.11.30
passages.text: ah pereant Baiae, crimen amoris, aquae!

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.1
passages.text: Quid mihi desidiae non cessas fingere crimen,

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.2
passages.text: quod faciat nobis Cynthia, Roma, moram?

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.3
passages.text: tam multa illa meo divisast milia lecto,

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.4
passages.text: quantum Hypanis Veneto dissidet Eridano;

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.5
passages.text: nec mihi consuetos amplexu nutrit amores

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.6
passages.text: Cynthia, nec nostra dulcis in aure sonat.

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.7
passages.text: olim gratus eram: non ullo tempore cuiquam

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.8
passages.text: contigit ut simili posset amare fide.

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.9
passages.text: invidiae fuimus: num me deus obruit? an quae

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.10
passages.text: lecta Prometheis dividit herba iugis?

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.11
passages.text: non sum ego qui fueram: mutat via longa puellas.

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.12
passages.text: quantus in exiguo tempore fugit amor!

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.13
passages.text: nunc primum longas s cognoscere noctes

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.14
passages.text: cogor et ipse meis auribus esse gravis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.15
passages.text: felix, qui potuit praesenti flere puellae

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.16
passages.text: (non nihil aspersus gaudet Amor lacrimis),

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.17
passages.text: aut, si despectus, potuit mutare calores

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.18
passages.text: (sunt quoque translato gaudia servitio).

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.19
passages.text: mi neque amare aliam neque ab hac desistere fas est:

passages.label: Prop. 1.12.20
passages.text: Cynthia prima fuit, Cynthia finis erit.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.1
passages.text: Tu, quod saepe soles, nostro laetabere casu,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.2
passages.text: Galle, quod abrepto s amore vacem.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.3
passages.text: at non ipse tuas imitabor, perfide, voces:

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.4
passages.text: fallere te numquam, Galle, puella velit.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.5
passages.text: dum tibi deceptis augetur fama puellis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.6
passages.text: certus et in nullo quaeris amore moram,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.7
passages.text: perditus in quadam tardis pallescere curis

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.8
passages.text: incipis, et primo lapsus abire gradu.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.9
passages.text: haec erit illarum contempti poena doloris:

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.10
passages.text: multarum miseras exiget una vices.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.11
passages.text: haec tibi vulgaris istos compescet amores,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.12
passages.text: nec nova quaerendo semper amicus eris.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.13
passages.text: haec non sum rumore malo, non augure doctus;

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.14
passages.text: vidi ego: me quaeso teste negare potes?

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.15
passages.text: vidi ego te toto vinctum languescere collo

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.16
passages.text: et flere iniectis, Galle, diu manibus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.17
passages.text: et cupere optatis animam deponere labris,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.18
passages.text: et quae deinde meus celat, amice, pudor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.19
passages.text: non ego complexus potui diducere vestros:

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.20
passages.text: tantus erat demens inter utrosque furor.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.21
passages.text: non sic Haemonio Salmonida mixtus Enipeo

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.22
passages.text: Taenarius facili pressit amore deus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.23
passages.text: nec sic caelestem flagrans amor Herculis Heben

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.24
passages.text: sensit ab Oetaeis gaudia prima rogis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.25
passages.text: una dies omnis potuit praecurrere amantes:

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.26
passages.text: nam tibi non tepidas subdidit illa faces,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.27
passages.text: nec tibi praeteritos passast succedere fastus,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.28
passages.text: nec sinet: addictum te tuus ardor aget.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.29
passages.text: nec mirum, cum sit Iove dignae proxima Ledae

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.30
passages.text: et Ledae partu gratior, una tribus;

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.31
passages.text: illa sit Inachiis et blandior heroinis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.32
passages.text: illa suis verbis cogat amare Iovem.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.33
passages.text: tu vero quoniam semel es periturus amore,

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.34
passages.text: utere: non alio limine dignus eras.

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.35
passages.text: qui tibi sit felix, quoniam novus incidit, error;

passages.label: Prop. 1.13.36
passages.text: et quotcumque voles, una sit ista tibi.

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.1
passages.text: Tu licet abiectus Tiberina molliter unda

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.2
passages.text: Lesbia Mentoreo vina bibas opere,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.3
passages.text: et modo tam celeris mireris currere lintres

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.4
passages.text: et modo tam tardas funibus ire rates;

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.5
passages.text: et nemus omne satas intendat vertice silvas,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.6
passages.text: urgetur quantis Caucasus arboribus;

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.7
passages.text: non tamen ista meo valeant contendere amori:

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.8
passages.text: nescit Amor magnis cedere divitiis.

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.9
passages.text: nam sive optatam mecum trahit illa quietem,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.10
passages.text: seu facili totum ducit amore diem,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.11
passages.text: tum mihi Pactoli veniunt sub tecta liquores,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.12
passages.text: et legitur Rubris gemma sub aequoribus;

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.13
passages.text: tum mihi cessuros spondent mea gaudia reges:

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.14
passages.text: quae maneant, dum me fata perire volent!

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.15
passages.text: nam quis divitiis adverso gaudet Amore?

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.16
passages.text: nulla mihi tristi praemia sint Venere!

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.17
passages.text: illa potest magnas heroum infringere vires,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.18
passages.text: illa etiam duris mentibus esse dolor:

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.19
passages.text: illa neque Arabium metuit transcendere limen

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.20
passages.text: nec timet ostrino, Tulle, subire toro,

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.21
passages.text: et miserum toto iuvenem versare cubili:

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.22
passages.text: quid relevant variis serica textilibus?

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.23
passages.text: quae mihi dum placata aderit, non ulla verebor

passages.label: Prop. 1.14.24
passages.text: regna vel Alcinoi munera despicere.

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.1
passages.text: Saepe ego multa tuae levitatis dura timebam,

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.2
passages.text: hac tamen excepta, Cynthia, perfidia.

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.3
passages.text: aspice me quanto rapiat fortuna periclo!

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.4
passages.text: tu tamen in nostro lenta timore venis;

passages.text: et potes hesternos manibus componere crines

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.6
passages.text: et longa faciem quaerere desidia,

passages.text: nec minus Eois pectus variare lapillis,

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.8
passages.text: ut formosa novo quae parat ire viro.

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.9
passages.text: at non sic Ithaci digressu mota Calypso

passages.label: Prop. 1.15.10
